subject.title: docs(onboarding): finalize phase status and phase 7 decision

question: Should phase 7 formally recommend CLI-side auto-doctor as the next onboarding resilience direction, while leaving gateway minimal-surface mode unapproved pending separate security review?
rationale: The PR intentionally converts an unresolved startup-policy boundary into a documented recommendation; correctness of the prose does not establish that this is the project’s chosen product and security direction.

options.title: Confirm CLI-side auto-doctor
options.body: Approve the memo’s recommended CLI-owned path as the documented next direction, with gateway minimal-surface work remaining explicitly deferred.

options.title: Keep phase 7 neutral
options.body: Document the completed phases but remove the recommendation until the onboarding and security owners make a recorded decision.
